Qualcomm Initiates Workforce Reduction in India Amid Business Restructuring

items.title: Cognizant Deploys 25,000 Professionals for Claude Frontier AI Initiative
items.snippet: Cognizant has created a Claude Frontier Capability Group of more than 25,000 professionals to accelerate enterprise AI adoption and apply Anthropic’s Claude throughout business operations. The effort, announced Nov. 10, offers managed services, specialised AI engineers and more.
